caveats: Duration (TLT) HELPS only if the unwind is a growth-scare (inflation_score < 0); if rates are still rising, duration adds risk, not safety.
Banks (XLF) are NOT a clean hedge — a liquidity event stresses credit; favor them only on a steepening-with-stable-credit read.
REITs (XLRE) are rate-sensitive — avoid while real yields are rising.
defensive_tilt.rate_sensitive_note: Growth-scare driver (growth weak / inflation falling): long duration (TLT) can HELP and banks' loan-loss risk dominates — duration as a hedge, banks still avoid.
